timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What's EDR? Is it just better antivirus?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Much more, Peter. Antivirus checks files against known signatures - like matching fingerprints in a database. EDR monitors behavior - it watches what processes do, not just what they are. A legitimate tool like PowerShell doing something suspicious triggers an alert.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Like a security camera instead of a bouncer?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Perfect analogy. EDR records every process creation, network connection, file modification, and registry change. When an attack happens, you can reconstruct the entire timeline - from initial access to lateral movement to data exfiltration.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: The key capabilities are: real-time detection, automated response, threat hunting, and forensic investigation. CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint are the leaders.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: They try. EDR tampering is a common attack technique - MITRE ATT&CK technique T1562. Attackers use BYOBD - Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver - to gain kernel access and kill EDR processes. That's why driver blocklisting is critical.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: EDR evasion is a cat-and-mouse game. Attackers use living-off-the-land techniques - using legitimate system tools like PowerShell, WMI, and certutil to avoid detection. EDR vendors respond with behavioral analytics and ML.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: How do you make EDR more effective?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Tune your rules to reduce false positives. Integrate with SIEM for centralized visibility. Use threat intelligence feeds to update detections. And most importantly, have a SOC team that actually investigates alerts.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Interview tip: explain how EDR differs from traditional antivirus, describe EDR evasion techniques, and discuss how to improve EDR detection coverage. Blue team roles always ask this.
